evidence.title: TSMC fab equipment demand nearly doubles in six months - AI surge pushes 2026 CapEx toward $64B amid tool shortages
evidence.summary: Recent SEMICON Taiwan reporting says TSMC equipment demand rose to about 1.9 times the level estimated at the end of 2025 within six months, while 2026 capex expectations moved toward US$60-64B and tool shortages remain a constraint.

evidence.title: Solvay to more than double Taiwan chip peroxide capacity, targets tripling electronic-grade business
evidence.summary: Solvay plans to more than double ultra-pure hydrogen peroxide capacity in Taiwan by end-2026, citing stronger semiconductor demand and TSMC advanced-fab expansion; this is an external supply-chain capacity signal rather than direct equipment-order disclosure.

evidence.title: 公告：志聖 2026年8月合併營收8.66億元 年增60.73%
evidence.summary: 志聖公告2026年8月合併營收8.65806億元，年增60.73%；1-8月累計70.77366億元，年增83.37%。公告備註指出成長係因客戶需求提升。

evidence.title: 志聖H1獲利創新高EPS達7.16元 7月營收以11.68億元再登頂
evidence.summary: 志聖表示2026營運受惠先進封裝與先進PCB兩大動能；AI/HPC帶動Foundry與OSAT增加先進封裝資本支出，推升設備接單與出貨，半導體營收占比提升。

evidence.title: 辛耘8月營收寫新高/月增1成；自製設備動能靚
evidence.summary: 辛耘8月合併營收10.68億元，月增約10%、年增18.06%，創單月新高；公司表示自製設備至年底滿載、2026出貨量估增50%，2027依客戶預估仍滿載，部分客戶已預訂2028產能，製造業務占比提升有利產品組合。

evidence.title: 半導體廠務工程五強訂單塞爆 在手訂單衝8,800億 後續有望叩關兆元
evidence.summary: 報導彙整五家廠務工程業者最新在手訂單合計逾8,800億元；其中亞翔約4,400億元、漢唐約1,939億元、帆宣約1,351億元、洋基工程約517億元，並連結台積電多座晶圓廠建置與後續發包需求。

evidence.title: 帆宣：訂單能見度達2028年 日本德國同步施工
evidence.summary: 帆宣董事長表示在手訂單1,351億元、能見度至少至2028年，並支援台積電日本二廠與德國廠施工，2029-2030相關專案亦已進入規劃。

evidence.title: 洋基工程在手訂單居高檔，續擴美/東南亞市場
evidence.summary: 洋基工程2026年第一季底在手訂單517.7億元；ASML林口、資料中心、美系記憶體南部建廠與高雄商辦等大型專案支撐認列，並擴大東南亞與美國布局。

evidence.title: 台積電全球擴廠最大贏家？漢唐海外營收將首度超車台灣
evidence.summary: 漢唐截至2026年5月底已簽約未認列金額約1,939億元、創新高，未來2至2.5年營收具能見度；管理層指出需求強，主要挑戰轉為人力、供應鏈與基礎設施執行能力。

evidence.title: Japan protests as China slaps new measures against its exports of a key chipmaking material
topics: semiconductor equipment policy or export restrictions
evidence.summary: China imposed provisional anti-dumping cash deposits on Japanese dichlorosilane imports, adding a fresh regional semiconductor-material trade-policy risk. The evidence does not directly establish a change in TSMC equipment orders or the six tracked suppliers.
